rawRetro.summary: Repair round 1: the only observed failure was the factory format:check failing on AGENTS.md. The application feature code (materials + read-only assistant) was already formatted, linted and passing its focused test; the stray blank line in the template-shipped AGENTS.md was the sole blocker.

blockers.title: Prettier rejects AGENTS.md shipped with the task template
blockers.symptom: `prettier . --check '!.github/**'` exits 1 with `[warn] AGENTS.md` even though the task changed no file under AGENTS.md and `format:auto` exited 0.
blockers.rootCause: AGENTS.md in the generated application baseline contains two consecutive blank lines between the "Factory task termination" paragraph and the "## Controlled failed-delivery smoke" heading. Prettier collapses this to one blank line. The blank line was introduced by the base-branch template commit e318f4e ("test: add opt-in controlled failed delivery smoke (#404)"), which added the section with an extra newline, so any task on this baseline would fail format:check regardless of its own changes.
blockers.resolution: Removed the extra blank line in AGENTS.md by running Prettier on the file. The factory command `prettier . --check '!.github/**'` now reports all matched files conform. No verification was weakened: .prettierignore and the ignored .github tree are unchanged.

improvements.title: Template AGENTS.md shipped with a Prettier violation
improvements.detail: Commit e318f4e appended the controlled failed-delivery smoke section to AGENTS.md with two blank lines before its heading, which fails the template's own format:check on every freshly generated application until an agent edits AGENTS.md. The template's committed AGENTS.md should be Prettier-clean so generated baselines do not inherit this failure.
improvements.suggestedChange: Run Prettier on the template AGENTS.md before committing template section changes (or add a formatting check on the template itself), and fix the source template so the extra blank line is removed at the template level rather than per generated application.

evaluation.summary: 本次需求（只读资料助手 + 资料可见范围 + 会话持久化）所用的 NocoBase3 基础能力总体可用：AI 员工/工具注册与运行时 enabledTools 边界、离线 Registry 聊天界面与就绪门控、permission set/getEffective 身份解析、迁移/种子与 ServiceProvider 装配都被应用按公开指引正确使用。主要缺口有两类：一是员工级 skillSettings.enabledTools 没有文档化的注册期写入路径，Agent 只能自行组合 getEmployee+upsertEmployee；二是生成基线 AGENTS.md 违反自身 Prettier 检查，迫使一次修复轮（模板侧根因）。受环境限制，验收环境未配置 LLM 服务，B01–B05 助手问答链路 blocked（B06 诚实不可用通过），且当前模型无法读取 PNG，UI 未评。

modules.name: AI 员工定义、工具注册与运行时工具边界
modules.scope: 应用如何用框架公开入口声明一个 AI 员工和它唯一可调用的后端工具，以及框架如何在运行时把模型可用工具收窄到员工级 allowlist。
modules.limitations: 未核对插件内置员工/工具的完整清单；未运行应用来观察模型实际收到的 tool schema；QA 因缺少 LLM 服务未能验证模型是否真的只调用该工具。

requirements.need: 只读资料助手必须在模型可用工具层面被限制为唯一检索工具，不能只靠提示词约束。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责员工定义、工具声明、运行时按 skillSettings.tools/enabledTools 过滤与持久化；应用负责选择 allowlist 内容与业务工具实现。
requirements.recommendedUsage: server-runs.md 推荐子类 AIResourceRegistrar 并在 ServiceProvider.boot 中注册；capabilities.md 说明持久字段在 AI 设置中管理。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用按该流程注册，并用 getEmployee+upsertEmployee 写入 enabledTools=[search-materials]；运行时 context.js 只暴露该工具。

requirements.need: 助手回答必须引用资料来源，资料不足时必须明说而不是编造。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 systemPrompt/systemPromptMode、i18n/introduction 与工具返回通道；事实性规则与拒答策略由应用负责。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 defineAIEmployee 写 systemPrompt、用 defineTools 写 schema 与 invoke 返回。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用把只依据资料、注明来源、资料不足即说明、禁止编造写入 systemPrompt，并在工具未命中时返回同样的提示。

requirements.need: 管理员对员工工具选择的运行时覆盖不能被每次启动重置。
requirements.responsibility: 框架在注册时保留已持久化的 skillSettings 覆盖值。
requirements.recommendedUsage: registerEmployee 用于声明，运行期调整留给 AI 设置。
requirements.actualUsage: registerEmployeeInRepository 以 current.skillSettings[key] 优先于 sourceSettings，应用写入的 allowlist 在重启后保持。

requirementFit.reason: defineAIEmployee/defineTools/AIResourceRegistrar 直接覆盖“一个 AI 员工 + 一个只读工具 + 员工级提示词”的需求；唯一非框架职责是事实性规则，由应用提示词与工具内容承担。

usability.reason: 注册是文档化的两步（registrar + provider.boot），但员工级 allowlist 没有文档化的注册期 API，只能 getEmployee+upsertEmployee 组合，增加了接入成本。

agentFriendliness.reason: 指引给出可运行的 registrar 示例并明确禁止 App 自建 AIManager，但 capabilities.md 把 skillSettings 推给 AI 设置却不说明代码路径，Agent 为此额外探索。

design.reason: 声明（options）、持久记录（skillSettings/enabledTools）与运行期覆盖被清晰分层，registerEmployeeInRepository 明确保留管理员覆盖。

reliability.reason: enabledTools 在运行时经 isToolSelected 强制执行，并在重启后保持，只读边界不依赖提示词；非法 allowlist 值被拒绝并给出错误。

modules.name: AI 会话传输、持久化与前端就绪门控
modules.scope: 对话界面如何从插件自带的 Registry 安装，会话/传输/员工发现如何由 provider 管理，以及发现未完成或缺模型时界面如何表现。
modules.limitations: 会话持久化与流式回答的端到端行为未被验证（无 LLM 服务，B01/B03 blocked）；未核对服务端会话存储表结构。

requirements.need: 对话要能持久化，刷新后恢复并继续提问。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供会话管理服务与前端会话清单/恢复 provider；应用负责在页面中限定单个员工。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按 chat-surfaces.md 安装 Registry UI，并用 AIChatProvider/AIChatWindow 承载会话。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用用 AIChatProvider(defaultEmployee=materials-assistant) 与 AIChatWindow；会话由插件服务管理。QA 因无 LLM 服务未能创建对话，B03 blocked。

requirements.need: 没有可用 AI 服务时必须显示真实不可用状态，不能以预写回复冒充助手。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 configurationStatus/configurationError/modelConfigurationError/hasEnabledModels 等可判定信号；应用负责呈现。
requirements.recommendedUsage: chat-surfaces.md 的就绪门控示例：分别检查状态、员工、模型错误与 hasEnabledModels。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用在这些信号不满足时渲染 AssistantUnavailable 并给出手工资料入口；QA B06 验证该状态真实且无预写回复。

requirements.need: 首次发送不能因为员工/模型发现尚未完成而失败。
requirements.responsibility: 框架 provider 在异步发现完成后纠正默认员工与模型选择，并给出 canSend。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在子组件读 useAI() 后门控；provider 亦支持首次渲染早于发现。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用仅在就绪后渲染 AIChatWindow；provider 在员工/模型到达后自动 select-employee/select-model。

requirementFit.reason: 聊天界面、会话服务、传输与就绪信号都已提供，能满足“可持久化对话 + 单一只读员工”的需求；但端到端问答在本次环境无法验证。

usability.reason: 安装走本机依赖的 Registry JSON，离线且版本对齐，并在目标已存在时拒绝覆盖；就绪判断字段含义明确。

agentFriendliness.reason: chat-surfaces.md 给出安装脚本与首个发送的验收检查，Agent 按此产出了可工作的页面并在无服务时给出诚实状态。

design.reason: provider 负责发现与选择同步、transport/会话服务分离、surface 组件只做呈现；首次渲染早于发现的边界被显式处理。

reliability.reason: provider 会在员工/模型到达后自愈选择并计算 canSend；无员工或请求失败进入 error，空模型进入带占位的 ready 并标出 modelError，QA 验证了不可用状态的诚实呈现。会话恢复仍未验证。

modules.name: 授权身份解析与资料可见范围
modules.scope: 应用如何用框架的 permission set/assignment/subject 模型解析调用者身份，并把业务可见性规则（主管可见分类资料、同事不可见）放在自己服务中。
modules.limitations: 未核对运行中 assignment 的实际存储读写与 UI 分配流程；未构造未授权请求做端到端 deny 断言；QA 仅手工验证页面级可见性。

requirements.need: 主管能看到分类资料，普通同事看不到，且不能通过助手绕过。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 permission set/assignment/subject 解析与“未注册集合默认拒绝”的边界；应用负责业务可见性规则与不注册该集合的选择。
requirements.recommendedUsage: SKILL 建议集合显式注册、路由认证、seed 提供初始角色配置；未注册集合即使 unrestricted 也 deny。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 seed 两个无 grant 的角色标记，service 用 getEffective 判定 manager，并刻意不把 materials 注册给授权库；页面与助手工具共用同一 where 规则。

requirements.need: 管理员能在 Users 页面调整角色而无需改代码。
requirements.responsibility: 框架把 assignment 作为可编辑的持久配置，并提供 subject/assignment API。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 seed 或授权服务写入初始配置，保留管理员后续修改。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 seed 按 code-and-seeds.md 的 bootstrap 模式直接写 authorizationPermissionSets/Assignments 行，Users 插件应用角色范围可分配。

requirementFit.reason: permission set/assignment/subject + getEffective 提供了以身份驱动可见性的标准模型，未注册集合默认拒绝为“资料不外泄”提供了边界；业务规则仍由应用服务承担。

usability.reason: 核心 API（getEffective/assign/protection）契约清晰，但 seed 侧无 authz 服务、需按 bootstrap 模式写原始行；以无 grant 的集合作为身份标记这一用法也只是隐含可推断。

agentFriendliness.reason: SKILL 与 9 个 reference 覆盖全面、可随包安装，Agent 能找到并正确使用 getEffective；信息量大，身份标记这一非典型用法需要自行推导。

design.reason: 代码声明/seed 初始配置/运行期请求强制被明确分层，root 的无限制保护与业务 set 的无 grant 身份标记在概念上自洽。

reliability.reason: 解析遇到未知 permission set 直接抛错而非静默授权，未注册集合默认 deny；QA 手工验证了同事列表不含分类资料且直接访问被重定向。

modules.name: 数据层：迁移、种子与业务查询
modules.scope: 应用如何用框架的迁移/种子定义建立 materials 表与初始角色数据，并用查询/仓储 API 在可见性约束下读写资料。
modules.limitations: 未核对迁移执行历史与 checksum 记录的实际内容；未覆盖多方言；QA 只验证了 SQLite 环境下的页面行为。

requirements.need: 建立 materials 表与初始角色数据，且升级/重复执行安全。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供迁移与种子的定义、构建器、连接与 checksum/事务语义；应用负责具体 schema 与安装数据。
requirements.recommendedUsage: nocobase-db 指引：migration 用 builder.createCollection 建结构，seed 用 repository/query 写安装数据。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用用 defineMigration(builder.createCollection) 建表，用 defineSeed(query 幂等插入) 写角色标记。

requirements.need: 业务服务能在可见性约束下查询并更新资料。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 QueryAdapter 与 Repository 的过滤/更新原语；应用负责 where 条件与业务规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 query.selectFrom/where/updateTable 表达数据访问。
requirements.actualUsage: service 用 database.query() 的 selectFrom(materials).where(audience=all) 与 updateTable 实现 list/get/search/update。

requirementFit.reason: 迁移建表、种子写角色配置与 query/repository 数据访问正好覆盖本需求的数据层；可见性条件属于业务规则，由应用承担。

usability.reason: defineMigration/defineSeed 与 builder/repository/query 均有类型与可运行示例，接入路径明确。

agentFriendliness.reason: nocobase-db SKILL 按主题组织并直接给出迁移/种子示例，Agent 写出的文件与示例结构一致。

design.reason: 结构变更（migration）与安装数据（seed）职责分离明确；seed 无应用容器并被文档化限制，findOne 还拒绝无过滤全表读取。

reliability.reason: CollectionBuilder 为类型化 DDL，迁移/种子支持事务模式与 checksum 历史，查询在缺 filter/sort 时报 INVALID_FILTER 而不是全表扫描。

modules.name: 应用装配：ServiceProvider、HTTP 路由与认证
modules.scope: 应用如何按框架生命周期注册服务、在 boot 阶段接入 AI 资源、以路由贡献与认证中间件暴露业务 API，以及模板基线对格式检查的影响。
modules.limitations: 未运行应用验证路由的实际可达性与认证拒绝路径；未核对认证插件内部的完整实现，仅读其公开声明。

requirements.need: 把业务 service、AI 资源与 HTTP 路由在启动时按序装配并受认证保护。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 ServiceProvider 生命周期、路由贡献模型与认证中间件；应用负责注册内容与顺序。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 provider register 注册 token、在 boot 解析依赖；路由用 defineApiRoutes 并加认证中间件。
requirements.actualUsage: MaterialsServiceProvider.register 用 container.singleton 注册服务，boot 中 container.has(aiManagerToken) 后动态 import 注册 AI 资源；页面路由经认证访问。

requirements.need: 生成的应用基线不应在自身 format 检查上失败。
requirements.responsibility: 模板应提供格式干净的初始文件；工厂负责执行 format:check。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 模板提交前运行 Prettier，使生成基线通过自身 format:check。
requirements.actualUsage: 基线 AGENTS.md 在标题前多一个空行，导致 prettier . --check 失败，修复轮只能用 Prettier 改写该应用副本。

requirementFit.reason: ServiceProvider 生命周期、路由贡献与认证中间件覆盖应用装配需求；模板格式缺陷属于模板侧，不影响能力覆盖。

usability.reason: 生命周期与路由工厂 API 小而明确，register/boot 的“所有 provider boot 完成后才 start”语义清晰。

agentFriendliness.reason: app-development SKILL 的能力映射帮助 Agent 选对包，但模板基线在首次格式检查即失败，白耗一轮修复。

design.reason: 注册表对重复 provider 名与阶段顺序有断言，路由贡献是纯工厂对象，关注点分离清楚。

reliability.reason: 阶段由断言驱动、失败即置 failed；应用用 container.has(aiManagerToken) 使 boot 在 AI 插件缺席时安全跳过，动态 import 避免循环依赖。

findings.title: 员工级 enabledTools 构成运行时只读边界，且跨重启保持
findings.detail: 员工可用工具由 skillSettings.tools 与 enabledTools 组装后再经 isToolSelected 过滤，web-search 等在未显式配置时被删除，注释明确 selection 不是 capability grant、任何注入都不能绕过员工配置；registerEmployeeInRepository 以已持久化值优先，保证运行期收窄不会在重启后被声明覆盖。
findings.impact: 应用的“只读资料助手”因此不依赖提示词，模型在工具层面拿不到写入/联网/通用数据工具，权限外资料也不可能经工具进入模型。
findings.suggestedChange: 无需修改；建议在 Skill 中把“用 enabledTools 做只读边界”写成明确推荐模式并给出一行注册期示例。

findings.title: AI 前端以离线、版本对齐的 Registry 安装，并提供可判定的就绪/不可用信号
findings.detail: chat-surfaces.md 的 Option 1 从应用已解析的 node_modules 读取 Registry JSON 安装 UI，离线、与运行版本一致、目标已存在时拒绝覆盖；playbook 同时规定必须分别检查 configurationStatus、employees、modelConfigurationError 与 hasEnabledModels，provider 也据此暴露稳定信号并在发现完成后自愈选择。
findings.impact: 生成的应用无需联网或源码检出即可得到与插件同版本的聊天界面，并能诚实呈现“未配置 AI 服务”而不是伪装回答；本案例的 B06 正是靠这些信号通过。
findings.suggestedChange: 无需修改；可把“不可用状态必须真实”的验收点并入该 reference 的 first-send acceptance checks。

findings.title: 员工级 skillSettings.enabledTools 缺少文档化的注册期写入路径
findings.detail: capabilities.md 把 enabledTools/skillSettings 归为“administered in AI settings”并规定 Do not put them in the definition，server-runs.md 的注册示例只调用 registerEmployee(orderDesk)，而公开的 AIEmployeeManager 接口没有任何接收 skillSettings 的方法。需要把只读边界固化在代码里的应用，只能自行发现 getEmployee+upsertEmployee 并理解其合并语义（本案例即如此）。
findings.impact: Agent 为达到一个明确需求（代码保证只读）需要摸索未文档化的组合，增加了出错与误解“管理员可在 UI 放宽边界”的风险。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 server-runs.md 增加一节“在注册期设置员工级工具选择”，说明用 getEmployee+upsertEmployee 写 enabledTools 及其与管理员覆盖的关系；或在 AIEmployeeManager 上提供带 sourceSettings/skillSettings 的公开注册参数。

diagnosis.trigger: 应用需要在代码中声明员工只能使用一个只读工具，并按 server-runs.md 的注册流程接入。
diagnosis.expected: 指引给出一个受支持的注册期 API 或明确说明用 getEmployee+upsertEmployee 写 enabledTools 的推荐写法。
diagnosis.actual: 指引只把该字段指向 AI 设置，公开接口也没有相应参数，Agent 必须自行推断组合方式。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用通过 getEmployee 读取当前记录后再 upsertEmployee 写入 skillSettings.enabledTools 达成目标。
diagnosis.acceptance: server-runs.md 给出可复制示例，且示例在重启后仍保持 allowlist；Skill 的自动校验或人工评审能发现该缺项。

findings.title: 生成的基线 AGENTS.md 曾违反自身 Prettier 检查，迫使一次修复轮
findings.detail: 修复轮原始日志显示 AGENTS.md 在 403 行前多一个空行，prettier 将其删除后 diff 输出 403d402 <；retro 把 rootCause 归到模板提交 e318f4e，并标注 category=template、mechanizable=true。冻结快照中的 AGENTS.md 已被修复为单空行，但修复只作用于这个生成的应用，模板侧根因没有被本次材料证明已消除。
findings.impact: 每个在该基线生成的应用都会在 format:check 上失败一次，消耗一次修复轮并降低对“基线本身可运行/可检查”的预期。
findings.suggestedChange: 在模板仓库运行 Prettier 修正 AGENTS.md 源文件，并为模板自身加格式检查，避免生成基线再次继承。

diagnosis.trigger: 在一个由模板生成的新应用上运行 prettier . --check。
diagnosis.expected: 模板自带的 AGENTS.md 应通过该模板自己的格式检查。
diagnosis.actual: AGENTS.md 标题前存在多余空行，prettier 报 [warn] AGENTS.md 并以 exit 1 失败。
diagnosis.workaround: Agent 对应用副本运行 prettier --write 去掉空行（逐应用修复，不改模板）。
diagnosis.acceptance: 模板仓库的 AGENTS.md 在 prettier --check 下通过，且有检查防止再次引入。

findings.title: 验收环境未配置 LLM 服务，B01–B05 的助手问答链路无法执行
findings.detail: 验收报告 passed=false 且 authenticated=true：设置中 LLM services 为空，助手页显示真实不可用提示且无输入控件，因此回答、引用、会话恢复、基于更新资料回答、无依据拒答五条均记为 blocked；B06 通过，页面级权限也被手工验证。该阻塞来自测试环境缺少外部 AI 服务，不是 NocoBase3 的能力缺陷，也不构成“三次失败即框架缺陷”的证据。
findings.impact: 框架的端到端问答质量（模型是否只调用唯一工具、是否引用来源、是否拒答、会话是否恢复）在本次材料中仍未被观察，相关评分只能基于实现与页面级证据。
findings.suggestedChange: 验收环境提供可用的 LLM 服务或在说明中明确该用例以 blocked 发布，并把 B06 的“诚实不可用”作为该条件下的等价通过记录。

diagnosis.trigger: 在有权限数据与已装配助手的前提下运行浏览器验收。

evidence.excerpt:
The principal is the authenticated actor; `subjects` adds verified memberships such as teams, and the principal itself also matches grants. `authz.for(identity)` uses the identity it is given: resolve memberships before calling it, or install identity middleware and use `authz.middleware()`, which resolves them per request.

| `AuthorizationContext` member | Result                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `identity`                    | The identity the context was created for.                                                                                                       |
| `authorize(request)`          | The full decision: `permit`, `deny`, or `conditional` with `conditions`. For type `composite` the conditions are `CompositeResourceConditions`. |
| `can(request)`                | `true` only for `permit`. A conditional decision counts as `false`.                                                                             |
| `require(request)`            | Throws `AuthorizationDeniedError` unless the decision is `permit`.                                                                              |
| `snapshot()`                  | `{ unrestricted, permissions }` for the client; see [Snapshot](#snapshot).                                                                      |

Create one context per request and reuse it within that request only. Unknown types, conditional decisions without conditions and handler failures deny. Execute a conditional decision only through the adapter that understands its conditions.

evidence.excerpt:
`autoCall` is narrower than it reads, and in one case it does the opposite of what it sounds like. The runtime consults it only for `CUSTOM` tools; for `SPECIFIED` and `GENERAL` it is ignored entirely and automatic calling follows `defaultPermission === 'ALLOW'`. On a `CUSTOM` tool listed here, `autoCall` replaces `defaultPermission` altogether: `autoCall: true` makes the call automatic, overriding an `ASK` default rather than respecting it, and leaving `autoCall` out makes it ask, even when the tool declares `ALLOW`. So a `CUSTOM` tool listed in `tools` states `autoCall` either way. A value the definition sets is also written to the employee record the first time the employee is registered, and a stored `true` or `false` wins over whatever the definition says afterwards — once one is stored, changing `autoCall` in code does not change a deployed employee; the administrator changes it in AI settings.

`skills` and `tools` are the employee's declared capability set, but listing a tool is not always enough to reach it: a tool named by any registered Skill stays behind that Skill until the conversation loads it. Read [How Skills and Tools relate](#how-skills-and-tools-relate) before deciding which of the two lists a capability belongs in — the choice is not cosmetic, and the failure mode is a tool that never activates and never complains.

The persisted employee record carries more than the definition does — `enabled`, `builtIn`, `deprecated`, `about`, `defaultPrompt`, `skillSettings`, `knowledgeBase`, model settings. Those are administered in AI settings. Do not put them in the definition.

## Implement in this order

1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Declare `authz` on every entry client route (nested pages inherit it; an omitted one defaults to root-only or `'skip'` with a development warning), add `useCan` for action visibility and obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending and error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page and action grants, selected data scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; editing a seed does not update a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

## Enforcement rules

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.database.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from the database; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.
- `settings`, `composite` and `database.collection` are catalog types: a check on an unregistered item or action is denied with `RESOURCE_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED`. `page`, `user`, `notification` and Hub types are record types that declare actions only; their grants use `id: '*'` for every record.
- A composite action composes exactly the grants it lists, never another composite. A data scope targets the one collection its grant actions name, whose type must declare `recordAccess` (`database.collection` does). Grant page access separately; a page grant never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require` needs an unconditional permit and rejects conditional decisions. Business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial or missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving collection grants again.
- For simple business CRUD, keep the Repository route definition and bind each method to its composite action with `authz.database.authorizeRepository`. Multi-scope actions and workflow transitions need custom handlers. `authz.database.policyFor` folds collection grants; without its third argument it does not respect a business-action boundary.

evidence.excerpt:
## Permission sets

`definePermissionSet(key).title(title).grant(...grants).build()` from `@nocobase/authorization/permission-sets` returns `{ key, title?, grants }`. Each grant is `{ resource: { type, id }, actions: [{ action, policy? }] }`; build them with `authz.pages.grant(id)`, `authz.settings.grant(id, actions)` and a composite reference's `grant(...)` rather than by hand. A composite grant stores `policy: { type: 'composite', scopes }`, one value per data scope: a record access key such as `'recordsIOwn'`, or a record selection. An empty value `''` selects nothing. Titles accept strings or `{ key, ns }`.

| `authz.permissionSets`                                                                     | Contract                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `create(input)`, `update(key, input)`                                                      | A complete `{ key, title?, grants }` definition, not a partial patch    |
| `get(key)`, `list()`, `delete(key)`                                                        | Read and remove definitions                                             |
| `assign({ id?, permissionSet, subject })`, `revoke(id)`                                    | Create or remove an assignment                                          |
| `listAssignments(permissionSet?)`                                                          | Every assignment, or those of one set                                   |
| `replaceSubjectAssignments({ subject, managedPermissionSets, permissionSets })`            | Replace only the managed subset; preserve unrelated assignments         |
| `getEffective({ principal, subjects? })`                                                   | The sets an identity holds                                              |
| `protect({ owner, keys, allow?, requireActiveAssignment?, assignableTo?, unrestricted? })` | Declare code ownership and invariants; returns a release function       |
| `protection(key)`, `assertWritable(key, operation)`                                        | Read and enforce protection; `protection(key)?.unrestricted` marks root |
| `assertSubjectRemovable(subject)`                                                          | Ensure disabling or removing a subject leaves protected sets usable     |
| `withTransaction(transaction)`                                                             | Bind every store operation to a caller-owned transaction                |
| `notifyAssignmentsChanged(subject)`                                                        | Announce a change; subscribe through `authz.onGrantsChanged(listener)`  |

The platform protects the root and default sets. Root grants unrestricted access, accepts user assignments and requires a remaining active assignment; the default set's grants may be edited. Business features create their own editable sets and leave platform protection and audience assignments to their owner. Whether the current identity is unrestricted is `snapshot().unrestricted`.

Generic HTTP management rejects changes to a protected key. Owner-side service calls are trusted and bypass `assertWritable`. `requireActiveAssignment` and `assignableTo` are enforced by the assignment APIs. Relevant failures include `PermissionSetProtectedError`, `PermissionSetLastAssignmentError` and `PermissionSetSubjectNotAllowedError`.

Protected assignment changes run in a database transaction that locks the protected set before checking remaining active assignments. Custom subject `filterActive` callbacks must use the supplied transaction. When a business mutation owns the transaction, bind the service to that connection and notify after commit:

```ts
const subject = { type: 'user', id: userId };
await database.transaction(async (connection) => {
  const sets = authz.permissionSets.withTransaction(connection);
  await sets.assertSubjectRemovable(subject);
  await disableUser(connection, userId); // Application-owned mutation.
});
await authz.permissionSets.notifyAssignmentsChanged(subject);
```

Never separate the removal check from the user mutation's transaction. Use the application's existing store; replacing persistence is outside ordinary feature development.

## Check the installed plugins first

NocoBase packages may publish Skills under `.agents/skills/`. Current application templates run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` automatically through `postinstall`; run it manually if install scripts were disabled or that directory is missing or stale. Confirm that the package is a direct `@nocobase/*` dependency or a registered plugin before relying on its Skill. The common capability mappings are:

| The requirement sounds like                                                                   | Read the Skill for                    |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Approvals, multi-step processes, "when X happens then Y"                                      | `@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow`       |
| An assistant in the app: chat, reading files dropped into it, acting through tools you define | `@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee`    |
| Email, IM, or in-app messages                                                                 | `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification`   |
| Roles, permissions, per-user or per-record access                                             | `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization`  |
| Sign-in, registration, sessions                                                               | `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication` |
| File upload and metadata through Repository                                                   | `@nocobase/app-plugin-file`           |
| Translated text and language switching                                                        | `@nocobase/app-plugin-i18n`           |
| User administration and application-owned role assignment                                     | `@nocobase/app-plugin-users`          |
| Reading or writing data, schema changes, migrations                                           | `@nocobase/db`                        |

Read the relevant Skill before writing the feature, but treat this table as a map rather than an installed-package list. Implementing a permission system, a notification sender, or a scheduler by hand when a registered plugin provides one is the most expensive mistake available here.

## Factory task termination

Ordinary tasks and evaluation samples share the ceilings in `.github/scripts/task-policy.mjs`: five repair attempts, three observations of an identical failure per criterion/check, at most one five-hour Handoff, and ten hours of active implementation/repair/QA time. An evaluation plan can only tighten these limits. Pipeline state carries counters, failure fingerprints and elapsed time across handoffs and explicit recoveries; never clear them to get a task through.

A terminal limit saves `task-diagnostic.json` and `task-diagnostic.md`, preserves the patch and raw evidence, and runs at most one additional fifteen-minute read-only diagnosis using the independent reviewer. This cleanup cannot resume repairs, dispatch another continuation, or authorize final verification. Failed tasks still publish reports and create or update a build PR marked failed when a safe code diff exists. They may attempt preview packaging and deployment once without restarting repair or QA; preview failure does not block the report or PR or change the failed task status. Missing patches or empty diffs must be reported explicitly rather than fabricating a PR. Stopped checkpoints are not recoverable. Reject direct GitHub Re-run attempts for implementation/repair: they start fresh runners without restoring the previous attempt. Use explicit checkpoint recovery in a new Run for recoverable failures. Attribute framework, Skill, template, application, factory and environment issues from evidence; repeated failures alone are not proof of a NocoBase3 defect. Preserve unknown causes and incomplete diagnoses.
